name: Food page: daily Protein macro label is visible
description: Checks the day-level Protein macro label is visible in the nutrient summary.
descriptionHtml: Checks the day-level Protein macro label is visible in the nutrient summary.
statusMessage:
AssertionError: assert False
 +  where False = is_visible_with_retry(<Locator frame=<Frame name= url='https://master.d2qs4q5h8ul506.amplifyapp.com/app/food/'> selector="span.daily-limit-slider__label:has-text('Protein')">)
 +    where is_visible_with_retry = <pages.userFacingPages.food_page.FoodPage object at 0x7fab2b7a1310>.is_visible_with_retry
 +      where <pages.userFacingPages.food_page.FoodPage object at 0x7fab2b7a1310> = <test_food.TestFoodPageDailyMacros object at 0x7fab40541820>.food
 +    and   <Locator frame=<Frame name= url='https://master.d2qs4q5h8ul506.amplifyapp.com/app/food/'> selector="span.daily-limit-slider__label:has-text('Protein')"> = daily_macro_label('Protein')
 +      where daily_macro_label = <pages.userFacingPages.food_page.FoodPage object at 0x7fab2b7a1310>.daily_macro_label
 +        where <pages.userFacingPages.food_page.FoodPage object at 0x7fab2b7a1310> = <test_food.TestFoodPageDailyMacros object at 0x7fab40541820>.food
